_budget: USD spend ceiling (default 5). null = unmetered (subscription providers): the cost-unknown auto-decision guard is disabled; the round cap and the trajectory bound are the sole spend guards.
_metered: optional boolean overriding derived metered-ness (derived: true unless budget is null). metered: false with a numeric budget keeps the ceiling but skips the cost-unknown guard.
_backend: which agent CLI drives the run: 'opencode' (default) or 'claude'. The claude route needs the claude CLI installed locally and exactly one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (bare profile) or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (native profile) exported, with LLM_API_KEY unset; a wrong credential environment fails at run entry before any spend. The model keeps its provider/model prefix here either way.
